cases.title: Record Visited Link to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visited links are recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that the correct link is recorded to the Global History after a server redirect occurs.

cases.title: Launch history link in browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete a History entry
cases.description: Verify that a History entry is successfully deleted when a delete action is performed on it.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple history entries are deleted when the delete action is executed on them.

cases.title: Deleted Multiple History Entries No Longer Displayed
cases.description: Verify that multiple history entries are no longer displayed in the history interface after being deleted.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Trigger a clear action on Global History and verify that the Global History is cleared.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, and None
cases.description: Verify that history items are correctly grouped by Day, Site, or None when grouping options are applied.

cases.title: Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is sorted per column.

cases.title: Reverse-Sort History per Column
cases.description: Verify that history is reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are shown.

cases.title: Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit recently visited sites via Back and Forward button dropdown menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by interacting with the Back and Forward button dropdown menu.

cases.title: New Session History File on New Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that opening a new browser window results in the creation of a new, empty session history file.

cases.title: New Session History File on Browser Restart
cases.description: Verify that a browser restart results in the creation of a new, empty session history file.

opinions.feedback: All requirements from R-073 through R-084 are fully covered by distinct, non-redundant test cases corresponding directly to the specified normal and boundary behaviors described in the text. No blockers were identified.
All requirements have corresponding valid test cases covering their explicitly stated operations and states.

analysis.analysis: Unit: firefox_browser_history. R-073: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is visiting a link, expected outcome is recording the link to the Global History. R-074: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is a server redirect after clicking a link, expected outcome is recording the correct link to the Global History. R-075: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is clicking on a history link, expected outcome is launching it in a browser window. R-076: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is a delete action on a History entry, expected outcome is that the entry is deleted. R-077: Multiple distinct behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Trigger is selection and deletion of multiple History entries, expected outcome is that the entries are deleted. 2) Trigger is viewing the history display after deletion, expected outcome is that the deleted entries are no longer displayed. R-078: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is a clear action on Global History, expected outcome is that the Global History is cleared. R-079: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is applying grouping options, expected outcome is that history items are grouped by Day, Site, or None. R-080: Multiple distinct behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Trigger is sorting per column, expected outcome is that history is sorted per column. 2) Trigger is reverse-sorting per column, expected outcome is that history is reverse-sorted per column. R-081: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is resizing history columns, expected outcome is columns resize to show or hide more of entries. R-082: Multiple distinct behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Trigger is history column show action, expected outcome is history columns are shown. 2) Trigger is history column hide action, expected outcome is history columns are hidden. R-083: Single straightforward acceptance criterion, single Normal test scenario warranted. Atomic behavior: Trigger is interacting with Back and Forward button dropdown menu, expected outcome is recently visited sites are re-visited. R-084: Multiple distinct behaviors. Atomic behaviors: 1) Trigger is opening a new browser window, expected outcome is a new, empty session history file is created. 2) Trigger is a browser restart, expected outcome is a new, empty session history file is created.

Each accepted test case targets the exact functionality explicitly described in the requirement text, with requirements covering multiple aspects (such as R-080, R-082, and R-084) appropriately split into distinct test cases for sorting/reverse-sorting, showing/hiding columns, and new windows/restarts respectively. There are no coverage gaps or redundant error scenarios.
